subject.title: [Feature] Re-enable dev channel distribution tag for npm releases

question: Should packaged snapshots remain on npm `alpha`, should a distinct npm `dev` channel return, or should package `dev` migrate or alias to `alpha`?
rationale: Current shipped behavior contains conflicting updater and release contracts, and the permanent choice affects compatibility, release security, versioning, support expectations, and documentation.

options.title: Make alpha canonical
options.body: Keep Tideclaw npm `alpha`, explicitly migrate package `dev` selections to it, and reserve `dev` for the moving git `main` workflow.

options.title: Restore distinct npm dev
options.body: Create a separately versioned, secured, and continuously verified moving-main npm channel with dedicated publishing ownership.

options.title: Maintain a documented alias
options.body: Point npm `dev` and `alpha` at identical snapshots with explicit compatibility, freshness, and eventual-retirement rules.

recommendation.title: Make alpha canonical
recommendation.body: Keep Tideclaw npm `alpha`, explicitly migrate package `dev` selections to it, and reserve `dev` for the moving git `main` workflow.

likelyOwner.reason: The original dev-channel commit, current release-policy history, release CODEOWNERS routing, and prior issue analysis make steipete the strongest available decision owner.
